description:
SRT Refurbished
A refurbished version of SafariJohn's Rules Tool
Version 1.1.0
Download
Source code

Taking a quick look at a rules.csv file in for example a text editor can already make you run for the closest fire exit.
With SRT Refurbished, which is a refurbished version of SafariJohn's Rules Tool (SRT), you might just feel
comfortable enough around rules.csv files! With this tool you can view, create, and edit rules with ease.

Consult the readme's Getting Started section if you have any trouble figuring things out.

Report any issues/bugs either here, or @ me on Discord @the_purple_nebula

Changes & New Features
- Themes selector in the options menu, choice from 9 different themes (see them below)
- Default dark theme to not blind you when wanting to work on rules in the evening
- A new setting to auto-center and resize the tool upon restart
- A new setting to reset the dividers upon restart

Important Notes
- First launch can cause a security prompt due to "unknown publisher", no clue how to fix this.
- This program does not officially support Mac. However, it should work correctly if run from the command line - see the readme's Installation section.

Themes
Dark | Dark - Purple | Dark - Red
Spoiler

Bright | Windows | Windows Classic
Spoiler

Ashes of The Domain | Starsector Remnant | Purple
Spoiler

Permission from SafariJohn
Spoiler

Changelogs

Spoiler
Version 1.1.0
Changes:
- Reworked the ID duplicate/overlap checking logic, ID changes no longer lag the input.
- Added ID changes confirmation step by either hitting Enter, clicking confirm, or clicking on a different UI panel.
- Check is now ran upon confirming the ID changes.

Version 1.0.1
Fixes:
- Fixed rule ID field red text staying red when it is/was a duplicate instead of returning to the normal text color.
New Stuff:
- Added a setting to disable rule id/name overlap due to lag caused by current rule overlap implementation.

Version 1.0.0
- Refurbished Look
New Stuff:
- Added a themes feature, allowing the user to change how the tool looks.
- Dark mode is now default, to not blind you in the evenings ^^
- Ships with 9 themes by default
- Original theme available for those who prefer it
- Added an option to reset window size & location upon next launch
- Additional option to reset dividers as well
- Both are enabled by default
Notes:
- Kept the original icon/logo design so that people don't have to get used to such a change
